text:
alexa (pm): quick sync — mapping existing customers to the hybrid-pack retrofit. need alignment on eligibility rules, launch gating, and contract constraints. short thread pls.

matt (sales): we have 5 pilots flagged. biggest constraint: customers expect reserved throughput SLAs preserved. no surprise token caps.

ria (legal): note: any change to entitlements requires amendment or explicit opt-in depending on the account. propose 60-day notice + migration credits for sensitive accounts.

samir (eng-prog): from infra side we can do per-tenant entitlement layers + a compat mode that preserves legacy limits. will need mapping table and a rollout plan. telemetry is critical to verify cost/latency delta.

matt (sales): compat mode is a must. also need an escape hatch for customers who refuse migration.

alexa (pm): proposed GA gating: (1) compatibility mode validated on 3 pilots, (2) per-tenant override infra in prod w/ <1% enforcement errors during canary, (3) legal amendment & billing mapping finalized. any additions? :eyes: 

samir (eng-prog): add metric thresholds: per-tenant 95p latency regression <5% and token-unit accounting parity within 0.5%. must have staging rollback tested. also a migration-backout playbook.

ria (legal): 60-day notice + migration-credit template okay. need final mapping table and sample amendment language from product to attach.

matt (sales): can we offer a one-time legacy credit for early pilots? helps close deals. suggest USD 3k–10k based on tier.

alexa (pm): noted. I'll draft a mapping table and migration playbook. tentative mapping snippet below for discussion:

```yaml
# entitlement mapping (legacy -> hybrid)
legacy_sku: "Reserved-XL"
mapped_sku: "Hybrid:dedicated-reserve"
overrides:
  throughput_limit: legacy_throughput
  priority_lane: true
credits:
  migration_credit_usd: 5000
compat_mode: true
```

samir (eng-prog): tweak: make compat_mode an enum to support 'preserve' and 'simulate' modes — e.g., compat_mode: 'preserve' not boolean. also we should include a telemetry_rate_limit flag so we can sample heavy customers.

matt (sales): +1 on preserve. timeline ask: pilot -> canary -> GA. recommend 6-week runway for pilot validation and legal sign-offs.

alexa (pm): plan: create PR for migration playbook + checklist. action items: @ria prepare amendment template by EOD Friday; @samir add a telemetry dashboard widget and canary scripts; @matt compile pilot account list and negotiation levers (credits, SLAs). I'll consolidate mapping table and ship initial doc. :shipit: 

ops-bot: Reminder — maintenance window scheduled 1767150000 (2026-03-25 02:00 UTC).

ria (legal): will do.

matt (sales): ack, will share pilot list tomorrow.

alexa (pm): thanks team — will follow up with PR link here.
